description: This file defines a builder class 'ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder' used to create immutable 'Thing' objects from scratch. It provides methods to set various properties of a 'Thing', such as attributes, features, metadata, lifecycle, and permissions. The builder pattern allows for constructing complex objects in a step-by-step manner, ensuring immutability of the resulting 'Thing'.

classes.name: ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable 'Thing' instances from scratch by setting various properties like attributes, features, lifecycle, and permissions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the builder.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of the 'Thing' using an Attributes object.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of the 'Thing' using a JSON object representation.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of the 'Thing' using a JSON string.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes from the builder.

methods.name: setEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes to an empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: setNullAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes to a null Attributes instance.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute using a JSON pointer and value.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute by its JSON pointer.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the ThingDefinition for the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setNullDefinition
methods.description: Sets the ThingDefinition to null (or NullThingDefinition).

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the current ThingDefinition.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a feature by a Feature object.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a feature using a feature ID.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a feature with an ID, definition, and properties.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a feature with an ID and properties.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by feature ID.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition of a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition of a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property of a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from a feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets multiple properties for a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties of a feature.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets multiple features at once.

methods.name: removeAllFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features.

methods.name: setEmptyFeatures
methods.description: Sets features to an empty set.

methods.name: setNullFeatures
methods.description: Sets features to null.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets features using a JSON object.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets features using a JSON string.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle state of the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision of the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision using a revision number.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Attaches metadata to the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets access permissions using JSON or other objects (deprecated).

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the 'Thing'.

methods.name: removePolicyId
methods.description: Removes the PolicyId from the builder.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the 'Thing' via a string or ThingId object.

methods.name: setGeneratedId
methods.description: Generates and sets a random Id.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the immutable 'Thing' object.
